result:
Decision: REJECT

Findings:
- severity: blocking
  category: script-correctness
  criterion: runtime
  surface: telemetry/aggregate.py:table_cost_per_finding_fixed
  raw_text: Token cost is duplicated per finding. table_cost_per_finding_fixed and table_per_reviewer_yield iterate over findings, adding cohort_total_tokens(run) for each. If a run surfaces N findings, its token cost is added N times.

- severity: major
  category: under-fitting
  criterion: spec-compliance
  surface: PRD.md:§17
  raw_text: The §17 invariant completely omits any reference to --enabled-tools. The rubric requires this cross-cut to be anchored consistently alongside --model, --auto, telemetry split, and cross-family review.

- severity: major
  category: spec-internal-consistency
  criterion: internal-consistency
  surface: tools/conventions/commit-body-recipe.md:Reviewer pass on a feature branch
  raw_text: Example 2 (Role: reviewer) omits the mandatory Telemetry-row: trailer. Reviewer passes are droid exec invocations per §17.1 and must link their telemetry row so that review cost can be attributed properly.

- severity: minor
  category: spec-internal-consistency
  criterion: internal-consistency
  surface: tools/conventions/commit-body-recipe.md:Disposition commit
  raw_text: Example 3 formats dispositions as F-1a2b3c:fixed@abc1234, which contradicts the instruction block above it that specifies "<comma-separated disposition commits, if this run closes findings>".

Family-self-id: google

Reach: files-only

Notes: The token duplication in aggregate.py invalidates the §13 evaluation metrics, requiring a blocking rejection. The missing --enabled-tools anchor in PRD §17 and the dropped Telemetry-row in Example 2 also require correction before merge.
